name: Sympathy for Patricians
source:
"I remember when that darling stallion was first brought to the palace..."

Set in the Imperial Harem of the Ottoman Empire, circa 1600, 'Sympathy for Patricians' is an otome inspired story about a servant caught between the love of a concubine and the Sultan. 

[From [url=https://zunova.itch.io/sympathy-for-patricians]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我还记得那匹讨人喜欢的骏马初次被带进王宫时的模样……”

《Sympathy for Patricians》以1600年前后的奥斯曼帝国后宫为背景，是一部受乙女游戏启发的作品，讲述了一名侍从夹在宠妃与苏丹的爱意之间左右为难的故事。

[摘自[url=https://zunova.itch.io/sympathy-for-patricians]itch.io[/url]]
